Expiration.description_en:
The expiration attributes of the lifecycle rule for the object. For versioning-enabled buckets, the specified expiration attributes apply only to the current version of the object.

NoncurrentVersionTransition.description_en:
The storage class conversion in a valid lifecycle rule that specifies when OSS converts noncurrent versions of objects to the IA or Archive storage class during their valid epoch.
The time to convert Standard objects to the Archive storage class must be longer than the time to convert them to the IA storage class
NoncurrentVersionTransition.description_zh:

AllowSmallFile.description_en:
Specifies whether to convert objects smaller than 64 KB to the IA, Archive, or Cold Archive storage class when the lifecycle rule is configured based on the last access time. Valid values:

true (default): All objects including those smaller than 64 KB are converted. Objects smaller than 64 KB are billed as 64 KB. Objects equal to or larger than 64 KB are billed based on their actual sizes. Setting this parameter to true may increase storage costs.

false: Objects smaller than 64 KB are not converted
AllowSmallFile.description_zh:
基于最后一次访问时间设置生命周期规则时，指定是否将小于64 KB的Object转储为低频、归档、冷归档文件类型。取值如下：

true（默认值）：转储包含小于64 KB在内的所有Object。当Object小于64 KB时，按照64 KB计算。当Object大于或等于64 KB时，按照实际大小计算。设置为true时，可能会增加存储费用。

false：不转储小于64 KB的Object
AllowSmallFile.title: 基于最后一次访问时间设置生命周期规则时，指定是否将小于64 KB的Object转储为低频、归档、冷归档文件类型。取值如下：  true（默认值）：转储包含小于64 KB在内的所有Object。当Object小于64 KB时，按照64 KB计算。当Object大于或等于64 KB时，按照实际大小计算。设置为true时，可能会增加存储费用。  false：不转储小于64 KB的Object。

ReturnToStdWhenVisit.description_en:
Specifies whether to convert the object back to the Standard storage class when the object is accessed after being converted to a non-Standard storage class. This parameter takes effect only when IsAccessTime is set to true. Valid values:

true: The object is converted back to the Standard storage class.

false (default): The object remains in the non-Standard storage class
ReturnToStdWhenVisit.description_zh:
指定Object转为非标准存储后，再次访问时是否将Object转为标准存储。只有当IsAccessTime设置为true时才有效。取值如下：

true：Object由非标准存储转为标准存储。

false（默认值）：Object仍为非标准存储

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage class to which the object is converted.

IA: Infrequent Access.
Archive: Archive.
ColdArchive: Cold Archive.

Objects in an IA bucket can be converted to the Archive or ColdArchive storage class, but cannot be converted to the Standard storage class

IA：低频访问
Archive：归档存储
ColdArchive：冷归档存储

IA Bucket中的Object可以转储为Archive或者ColdArchive存储类型，但不支持转储为Standard存储类型

Prefix.description_en:
The prefix that specifies the objects to which the rule applies. Duplicate prefixes are not supported.
If a prefix is specified, the rule applies only to objects in the bucket that match the prefix.
If the prefix is empty, the rule applies to all objects in the bucket

Transition.description_en:
The storage class conversion rule that specifies when OSS converts objects to the IA, Archive, or ColdArchive storage class during their valid lifecycle.
Standard objects in a Standard bucket can be converted to the IA, Archive, or ColdArchive storage class. The time to convert to the Archive storage class must be longer than the time to convert to the IA storage class. For example, if Transition IA has Days set to 30, Transition Archive must have Days set to a value greater than 30.

You can specify only one of Days and CreatedBeforeDate
Transition.description_zh:
指定Object在有效生命周期中，OSS何时将Object转储为IA、Archive和ColdArchive存储类型 。
Standard Bucket中的Standard Object可以转储为IA、Archive或ColdArchive存储类型，但转储Archive存储类型的时间必须比转储IA存储类型的时间长。例如Transition
IA设置Days为30，Transition Archive设置Days必须大于30。

Days或CreatedBeforeDate只能二选一
